PUNJAB LAND REVENUE ACT, 1967
PUNJAB
LAND REVENUE ACT, 1967
(Scale
of mutation fee)
[Gazette
of Punjab, Part I,
20th October, 2010]
No.1587-2010/1597-LR(I), dated
30-6-2010.---In exercise of the powers conferred by section 46 of the Punjab
Land Revenue Act, 1967 (W.P. Act XVII of 1967) and in supersession of all previous
notifications in this behalf, the Board of Revenue, Punjab is pleased to fix,
with effect from 1st July, 2010, in respect of the entries described in colomn
2 of the Schedule hereunder, the scale of mutation fee specified against such
entries, which fee shall be payable by the person in whose favour the entry is
made, excepting cases where no mutation fee is leviable under paragraph 7.33-A
of the Land Records Manual, Second Edition:--
SCHEDULE
S.No.
Description of Entry
Mutation Fee
1
2
3
1.
Entry on registered deed or devolution by inheritance, or
will, or mortgage in favour of a
banking company, or order of Revenue Officer making or affirming
partition under Chapter XI of the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967 directing the
incorporation in the record of a private partition.
Rs.500/--
2.
Entry based on redemption on certificate of release of
charge of mortgage under the Loans for Agricultural Purposes Act, 1973
(Federal Act XLII of 1973)
Rs.500/-
3.
Entry based on Tamaleek (gift in favour of legal heir)
up to 25 acres of agricultural land in rural area.
Rs.500/-
4.
Entry based on Tamleek (gift in favour of legal heir)
above 25 acres of agricultural land in rural area.
3% of the value of land according to the Valuation
Table notified by the District Collector in respect of the land situated
in the locality under the Stamp Act, 1899 (II of 1899).
5.
Entry based on gift of agricultural land in rural area in
favour of person other than legal heir.
3% of the value of land according to the Valuation
Table notified by the District Collector in respect of the land situated
in the locality under the Stamp Act, 1899 (II of 1899).
6.
Entry based on settlement compromise in favour of legal
heirs, in respect of agricultural land in rural area.
Rs.500/-
7.
Entry based on exchange of agricultural land in rural
area.
3% of the value of land according to the Valuation
Table notified by the District Collector in respect of the land situated
in the locality under the Stamp Act, 1899 (II of 1899).
8.
Decree, Rule of a Court or an order of a Court based on
mutual consent of parties in cases involving transfer of an immovable
property including sale, exchange, gift or mortgage, declaring or conferring
a right in or title to an immovable property.
2% of the value of land according to the Valuation
Table notified by the District Collector in respect of the land situated
in the locality under the Stamp Act, 1899 (II of 1899).
9.
Transfer of right or interest relating to an immovable
property that is to say, transfer of a right or interest relating to an
immovable property or an acknowledgment of such transfer by a development
authority, housing society, company or a developer and every instruments by
which a right or interest relating to an immovable property is being
transferred, registered, recorded or acknowledged by the authority, body,
society, company or developer, if transferred through oral mutation.
2% of the value of land according to the Valuation
Table notified by the District Collector in respect of the land situated
in the locality under the Stamp Act, 1899 (II of 1899).
10.
Entry which does not come within the purview of any of the
entries at Sr.No.1 to 9 above.
3% of the value of land according to the Valuation
Table notified by the District Collector in respect of the land situated
in the locality under the Stamp Act, 1899 (II of 1899).
2. The
Board of Revenue, Punjab is further pleased to direct that in the mutation fee
payable in respect of a mutation, the shares of the Patwari, Kanungo and
Revenue Officer shall be as under:--
(1)
Patwari who entered the mutation. Rs.100/-
(2)
Kanungo who verified the mutation. Rs.50/-
